import numpy as np
from numpy.linalg import norm
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from scipy import linalg

rng = np.random.RandomState(1137)
n = 500_000
x1 = rng.rand(n)
x2 = 0.3 * x1 + 0.1 * rng.rand(n)
X = np.column_stack([x1, x2]).astype(np.float32)
y = (X @ np.array([0.5, 2.0], dtype=np.float32)) + 0.1 * rng.rand(n).astype(np.float32)

a = LinearRegression(fit_intercept=False)
a.fit(X, y)
coef = a.coef_.astype(np.float32)
rmse_sklearn = np.linalg.norm(y - X @ coef) / np.sqrt(y.size)

coef_scipy, *_ = linalg.lstsq(X, y)
rmse_scipy = np.linalg.norm(y - X @ coef_scipy) / np.sqrt(y.size)

probe('rmse_sklearn', float(rmse_sklearn))
probe('rmse_scipy', float(rmse_scipy))
probe('rmse_ratio', float(rmse_sklearn / rmse_scipy))
